command_argv:
set -u
project=/home/wangjieren/code/1x5_Heisenberg_Pentamer
uid=$(id -u)
echo "=== identity ==="
hostname
date -Is 2>/dev/null || date
id
echo "uid=$uid user=$(id -un)"
echo "=== julia processes: exact account ==="
julia_pids=$(pgrep -u "$uid" -x julia 2>/dev/null || true)
if [ -n "$julia_pids" ]; then
  for pid in $julia_pids; do ps -o pid=,ppid=,etime=,pcpu=,pmem=,rss=,vsz=,stat=,comm=,args= -p "$pid"; done
else
  echo "none"
fi
echo "=== project pythonbatch processes ==="
batch_pids=$(pgrep -u "$uid" -f pythonbatch 2>/dev/null || true)
found_batch=0
for pid in $batch_pids; do
  args=$(ps -o args= -p "$pid" 2>/dev/null || true)
  case "$args" in
    *"$project"*) ps -o pid=,ppid=,etime=,pcpu=,pmem=,rss=,vsz=,stat=,comm=,args= -p "$pid"; found_batch=1 ;;
  esac
done
[ "$found_batch" -eq 1 ] || echo "none"
echo "=== resources ==="
free -h
df -h "$project"
nproc
echo "=== julia executable and project files ==="
for candidate in "$HOME/.juliaup/bin/julia" "/home/wangjieren/.juliaup/bin/julia" "/usr/local/bin/julia" "/usr/bin/julia"; do
  if [ -e "$candidate" ]; then stat -c "path=%n mode=%A size=%s mtime=%y" "$candidate"; fi
done
command -v julia || echo "command_v_julia=missing"
for f in "$project/Project.toml" "$project/Manifest.toml"; do
  if [ -f "$f" ]; then stat -c "path=%n mode=%A size=%s mtime=%y" "$f"; else echo "missing=$f"; fi
done
echo "=== lock files and observed holders (read-only) ==="
find "$project/results" -maxdepth 5 -type f \( -iname "*lock*" -o -name "batch.lock" \) -print 2>/dev/null | sort | while IFS= read -r f; do
  [ -n "$f" ] || continue
  stat -c "lock_path=%n mode=%A size=%s inode=%i mtime=%y" "$f" 2>/dev/null || true
  inode=$(stat -c "%i" "$f" 2>/dev/null || echo "")
  if [ -n "$inode" ]; then grep -E "[[:space:]]$inode[[:space:]]" /proc/locks 2>/dev/null || true; fi
  if command -v fuser >/dev/null 2>&1; then fuser -v "$f" 2>&1 || true; fi
done
